description: The fictional M04 order (NRV-PO-26-0457) with its customer written in vi, en or ja, walked to its confirmation sent; a synthetic reply asking when line 2 is delivered, read as a question, and a B03-shaped reply asking line 2 pulled in, PC answering the date asked or a later one. The graders build every case in the eval world (`dw_sales.evals.reply_drafts`); nothing here is a customer's.
